Você deveria fazer parte do Jusbrasil

Transformar o sistema de Justiça com tecnologia não é trivial. Estamos construindo uma inteligência artificial dentro de casa: o Jus IA tem 43% menos alucinações que IAs generalistas. Essa é a prova concreta de que aqui tecnologia não é discurso, e sustenta a nossa missão: elevar a justiça.

Lidamos com mais de 7 bilhões de documentos jurídicos e mais de 1.400 fontes de dados oficiais. É desafio de escala e precisão que poucas empresas no país enfrentam.

Somos 670 pessoas jusbrasileiras, quase metade em engenharia e produto, espalhadas por mais de 125 cidades no Brasil e fora. O modelo é remoto: você escolhe onde viver, a vaga não muda.

Aqui, quem chama pra si o problema sem dono e entrega algo acima do esperado cresce rápido. Quem prefere o caminho óbvio, não.

Conheça nosso impacto

  • site jurídico nº1 do mundo em número de acessos
  • mais de 20 milhões de usuários por mês
  • mais de 7 bilhões de documentos jurídicos de interesse público
  • mais de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados
  • 670 pessoas jusbrasileiras, quase metade em tecnologia e produto
  • presença em mais de 125 cidades no Brasil e fora
  • modelo remoto: liberdade de escolher onde viver, sem perder a vaga certa

Sobre a função

Buscamos uma pessoa Analytics Engineer para atuar como a ponte estratégica entre a infraestrutura de dados e a geração de insights. Você será responsável pela camada lógica e de governança, transformando os dados preparados pelo time de Platform em ativos semânticos prontos para consumo.

Seu objetivo será garantir a organização, disponibilidade e processamento eficiente dos dados, permitindo que os analistas de ponta foquem em análises prescritivas de alto valor. Valorizamos o uso de Inteligência Artificial para automatizar processos operacionais e buscamos alguém que veja na tecnologia uma aliada para elevar a qualidade e a velocidade das entregas.

Você trabalhará no time de Analytics Platform, colaborando de perto com Engenheiros de Dados, Analistas de Produto e Stakeholders para garantir que o dado seja o motor de decisão da companhia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Construir e gerir a camada semântica: Criar a camada lógica de dados, garantindo que as regras de negócio estejam centralizadas e consistentes para toda a empresa.
  • Governança e Organização: Atuar como guardião da qualidade e padronização dos dados, organizando-os de forma que sejam facilmente acessíveis antes de chegarem aos analistas.
  • Extração de Requisitos: Interface direta com stakeholders para traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos dimensionais eficientes.
  • Automação com IA: Implementar e fomentar o uso de ferramentas de IA para otimizar o desenvolvimento, a documentação e o processamento de dados.
  • Evolução Técnica: Manter e evoluir processos de orquestração, testes unitários e versionamento, aplicando as melhores práticas de engenharia ao contexto analítico.

Habilidades mandatórias:

  • SQL Avançado: Domínio para transformações complexas e otimização de queries.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência sólida em modelagem dimensional e ambientes analíticos.
  • Conhecimento prático em linguagens de programação (preferencialmente Python), sistemas de orquestração (como Airflow ou Dagster) e ferramentas de versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery): Conhecimento específico em otimização de tabelas e processamento no BigQuery
  • Data Warehousing: Experiência em arquiteturas de Data Warehouse ou Data Lakehouse, com foco em otimização de custos e performance.
  • Pensamento Crítico em IA: Familiaridade e abertura para o uso de IA Generativa no fluxo de trabalho.
  • CI/CD e Qualidade: Experiência com testes unitários e pipelines de integração contínua.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Experimentação: Vivência prévia com infraestrutura de Testes A/B.
  • Visão de Produto: Habilidade de atuar como um híbrido entre a técnica e a análise de negócio.

Informações Importantes

Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs). Acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes, criativos e representativos da sociedade. Por isso, buscamos intencionalmente atrair e incluir profissionais com deficiência em nosso time, promovendo um ambiente acessível, respeitoso e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Caso você participe de um processo seletivo afirmativo para Pessoa com Deficiência no Jusbrasil, nossa equipe de Talent Acquisition solicitará a apresentação do seu laudo médico ou do Certificado de Reabilitação Profissional emitido pelo INSS. O documento deve estar assinado e validado por profissional com CRM, e será analisado conforme os critérios estabelecidos nos artigos 89 e 90 da Instrução Normativa MTP nº 2, de 08/11/2021.

Ao fornecer essas informações, você declara que elas são verdadeiras e compreende que, em casos de incompatibilidade entre o laudo apresentado e os requisitos legais da vaga afirmativa, isso poderá ser considerado no processo de avaliação e eventual não preenchimento da posição.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per accepted task equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

Wir suchen selbständige Vertriebspartner / Handelsvertreter, die unser Produkt an Hotels in der DACH-Region vertreiben. Idealerweise hast du bereits Kontakte in der Hotellerie oder im Bereich Tourismus/Hospitality.

Summary

Gainwell Technologies is seeking an experienced Provider Outreach & Education Supervisor to lead provider outreach and education activities supporting California’s Medi-Cal program.

In this role, you will supervise a team responsible for engaging, educating, and supporting healthcare providers throughout California. You will help ensure providers have the information, training, resources, and operational support needed to successfully participate in the Medi-Cal program.

You will lead Provider Field Representatives, coordinate outreach and education activities, monitor team performance and deliverables, support complex provider issues, and partner with clients and internal teams to identify provider needs and improve the overall provider experience.

Your role in our mission

  • Supervise Provider Field Representatives responsible for conducting provider outreach, education, training, and relationship-management activities throughout California.
  • Plan, assign, and monitor provider outreach activities, field visits, training sessions, presentations, and other team deliverables to ensure contractual and operational requirements are achieved.
  • Identify provider education and training needs and help develop outreach strategies, educational materials, presentations, and other resources designed to improve provider understanding and engagement.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex provider questions and operational issues while partnering with internal teams and client stakeholders to research and resolve concerns.
  • Monitor provider outreach activities, team performance, field coverage, training effectiveness, and other operational measures and provide regular updates and reporting to leadership.
  • Lead, coach, train, and develop employees while managing performance, supporting professional development, and ensuring consistent execution of outreach and education expectations.
  • Evaluate provider feedback, operational trends, and existing processes to identify opportunities to improve provider education, engagement, service delivery, and the overall provider experience.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Six or more years of experience in provider relations, provider outreach, provider education, healthcare operations, training, healthcare consulting, Medicaid/Medi-Cal, or a related healthcare function.
  • Three or more years of leadership or supervisory experience, including responsibility for coaching, developing, and managing employee performance.
  • Experience working directly with healthcare providers, provider offices, medical groups, healthcare organizations, or other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, training, relationship-management, and communication skills with the ability to effectively engage healthcare providers, clients, employees, and internal business partners.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with experience identifying provider needs, resolving operational issues, and improving business processes.
  • Experience using business applications, reporting tools, customer relationship management systems, provider systems, or other technology used to track outreach activities and resolve provider issues.

What you should expect in this role

  • This is a remote position for candidates who reside in California supporting Provider Outreach and Education activities for California’s Medi-Cal program.
  • You will lead Provider Field Representatives responsible for engaging, educating, and supporting healthcare providers throughout assigned California territories.
  • Travel may be required to support provider visits, outreach activities, training sessions, meetings, and other business needs.
  • You will regularly interact with healthcare providers, client representatives, leadership, employees, and cross-functional business partners.
  • This role requires strong presentation and facilitation skills and the ability to effectively represent Gainwell during provider meetings, training sessions, and outreach activities.
  • You will manage multiple priorities, territories, outreach activities, and operational requirements in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

raw.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're hiring Operations Coordinators for our Collections & Recoveries team to have direct, honest conversations with customers every day about getting their accounts back on track, fairly and respectfully.

The impact you'll make:

A customer’s fallen behind on a credit card payment. They already know what they owe. What they don't know is whether taking our call means getting further behind, or getting somewhere. They need someone on the other end of the line who will tell them plainly what's owed and what their options are, listen to what's going on, and help them land on a plan that works for their life.

As an Operations Coordinator on the Collections & Recoveries team, you're that voice. Your job on every call is to be straightforward, be kind, and get to a plan that helps the cardholder move forward.

As Operations Coordinator, you will:

  • Speak with customers who've fallen behind on payment, understand their circumstances, and ask directly for what's owed, in full or through a workable payment plan.
  • Work with customers through pushback and objections, staying patient and persistent as you build toward a plan that works for them.
  • Follow established scripts, tools, and account guidelines to keep every conversation consistent, professional, and compliant.
  • Read a conversation quickly and adjust your approach, always keeping the ask in view.
  • Keep accurate, timely records of every call and outcome in our systems.
  • Meet daily and weekly targets for collections, call quality, and productivity.
  • Take coaching and feedback fast, and apply it on your very next call.
  • Flag anything unusual (a complex account, a dispute, a technical issue) to your manager right away for guidance.
  • Stay actively engaged with your team throughout your shift in Collaboration Room AI, our virtual, video-based team space where you and your teammates stay visible and connected in real time, the same way you would in a physical office.

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You can be firm and fair in the same conversation.
  • You're comfortable asking directly for payment and staying patient and persistent when a customer pushes back.
  • You stay calm and in control even when conversations get tense.
  • You seek out feedback and put it into practice.
  • You like structure and consistency, and you follow procedures accurately.
  • You enjoy being part of a connected, engaged remote team.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience in a phone-based, customer-facing role (collections, customer service, sales, or similar).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to consistently meet performance expectations in a metrics-driven environment.
  • Ability to work a remote schedule while maintaining an active presence in Collaboration Room AI throughout your shift, camera on outside of breaks and lunch.
  • Fast, reliable internet (minimum 80 Mbps download / 8 Mbps upload) and a private, quiet workspace.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Direct experience in consumer debt resolution.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Familiarity with contact center technology (e.g., dialers, case management tools).
  • Comfortable working with call center metrics.
  • Bilingual professional fluency in English and Spanish.
  • Proficiency with our key business technology platforms: Mac OS, Google Workspace, Tableau, and Slack.
  • Working knowledge of relevant financial regulatory requirements (e.g. FDCPA, TCPA, FCRA, BSA, SCRA, MLA, UDAAP).

Work Location & Virtual Team Culture:

  • This is a remote position for residents of AR, AZ, FL, KS, GA, MO, NC, SC, TN, TX, UT, and VA.
  • This role operates within a highly supportive virtual team environment. We rely on Collaboration Room AI, Slack and Google Meet for daily communication, coaching, and team huddles to ensure consistent support and performance alignment.

Schedule:

  • Depending on business need at time of hire, you may be offered one or more of the following shift options:
    • Shift A: M-F, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern Time
    • Shift B: M-F, 10:30 AM - 7:00 PM Eastern Time
    • Shift C: M-F, 12:30 PM - 9:00 PM Eastern Time

Compensation:

Starting hourly base pay range: $17.25 - $19.20

Bilingual (Spanish-English): $18.11 - $20.16

Your starting base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience.

Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

This position offers a clear path for internal progression. Based on the achievement of defined performance goals, you would have the opportunity for promotion within your first year of employment. After promotion, you would be eligible for incentive pay based on performance, in addition to your base hourly rate.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

Application Integrity:

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

Where industry intelligence is going next, and who's building it

For over five decades, the world's most sophisticated institutions have relied on IBISWorld to navigate uncertainty, identify opportunity and stay ahead of change. Banks, consulting firms, governments: when the stakes are high and the answer has to be right, they come to us.

That trust is our legacy, and it's our starting point. We're advancing beyond traditional research into AI-enabled, actionable intelligence, embedding human-verified insight directly into the workflows our clients live in so they can see further and decide faster. The ground is shifting in our industry, and we are the ones moving it.

You'd be joining at the most exciting moment to do so.

Why this role, right now

We're investing heavily in Client Services in Australia, raising the bar on how we hire, how we develop our people, and what great looks like. We're building a team with real momentum, genuine accountability, and the kind of culture people don't want to leave.

This is a high-impact seat on that team. You'll own a portfolio of key accounts, protect and grow ARR, and act as the trusted advisor your clients call first. You'll have real autonomy over how your book is run and a direct hand in shaping how a high-performing CS team operates.

If you're the kind of person who's quietly outgrown your current role, who wants to be surrounded by people as driven as you are, this is the one to look at.

What you'll own

You'll maximise the lifetime value of an assigned portfolio of key accounts. Two focuses, equally weighted: secure renewals & protect ARR, and drive growth by finding and closing the cross-sell and upsell opportunities hiding inside your book.

  • Own the end-to-end performance of your book: renewal rates, upsell revenue, and client health

  • Become the trusted advisor your clients call first, building relationships deep and wide enough to weather any renewal

  • Identify, qualify, and close expansion across products, integration & AI solutions, additional users, and new business units

  • Help clients embed our intelligence directly into their workflows and tools, turning a subscription into something they can't operate without

  • Build strategic account plans for high-value clients, with stakeholder maps, white-space analysis, and forecasted ARR uplift

  • Sit close to how the product is evolving, bringing client insight back to Product and Research to shape what we build next

  • Keep your pipeline, forecasts, and CRM records sharp enough to run the business on

Who thrives here

We hire for culture as deliberately as we hire for capability, and we're specific about it. The people who do their best work at IBISWorld:

  • Hold a high bar for the quality of their own work, without being asked to.

  • Internet Savvy: Stay up-to-date with online recruiting tools and strategies to effectively source and engage potential candidates.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in the staffing industry Education industry experience is a plus
  • Strong understanding of the recruiting process, including sourcing, interviewing, and placement.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a focus on phone outreach and relationship management.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, KPI-driven environment
  • Strong negotiation skills and the ability to manage multiple candidates and placements simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Bachelor's degree required

Why Join Us?

  • Significant growth potential
  • Competitive compensation package with uncapped commission.
  • Collaborative and supportive company culture focused on innovation and excellence.

Salary

  • $60,000 - $65,000, based on experience.
  • Commission eligible.
  • Comprehensive benefits and PTO package, including 401k, offered.

About Onward Group Holdings, LLC

Onward Group Holdings, LLC is a platform of specialized talent and workforce solutions brands that connect leading organizations with expert talent across high-demand industries. The company combines deep domain expertise, proven infrastructure, and an expansive talent network to deliver solutions that go beyond traditional staffing.

With nearly 20 years in business, Onward Group Holdings partners with companies, schools, and organizations to help them build high-performing teams and thrive in the future of work. It's divisions include Onward Search (Marketing, Creative & Technology), Onward Accessibility (Digital Accessibility), Onward Education (K-12 Education), and Talera (Behavioral Health).

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and a 401(k) program for eligible full-time employees, along with resources designed to support well-being and career development.

We have built a culture fostered on entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency. If you are energized by connecting people to opportunity, excited by emerging technologies, and motivated by measurable impact, you’ll fit in great with our team.

Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply.

We’re committed to making every part of our hiring process accessible and inclusive. If there’s any adjustments we can make to support you as you apply and interview, please reach out
.

Onward Search is an equal opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law.

*There is no application deadline for this posting because we are accepting applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Executive Recruiter (Startup & C-level Specialist)
description: Red Sky is a venture builder.  We conceptualize digital companies and bring them to life—but a startup is only as good as its leadership.

raw.title: Executive Recruiter (Startup & C-level Specialist)
raw.excerpt: Red Sky is a venture builder.  We conceptualize digital companies and bring them to life—but a startup is only as good as its leadership.
raw.description:
Red Sky is a venture builder. We conceptualize digital companies and bring them to life—but a startup is only as good as its leadership. We are looking for an Executive Recruiter who specializes in identifying, attracting, and closing elite C-level talent (CEO, CTO, CPO, Co-founders) capable of taking a startup from seed stage to global scale. This is a high-impact, highly autonomous role where you act as Red Sky's internal boutique executive search firm. If you understand the fundamental difference between a corporate manager and a startup builder, and have a strong footprint in the investment or tech ecosystem, we want to talk to you.

Your Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Executive Search: Lead confidential, high-stakes recruitment processes for C-level positions across our portfolio, from initial leadership profiling to successful placement and equity negotiation.

  • Ecosystem Networking: Proactively build and nurture an exclusive global network of proven entrepreneurs, seasoned tech executives, digital leaders, and industry advisors.

  • Rigorous Executive Assessment: Conduct deep competency and cultural fit interviews. You must accurately evaluate a candidate’s risk tolerance, entrepreneurial drive, and capacity to lead in high-uncertainty environments.

  • Hands-on Execution: At Red Sky, we don't rely on costly external executive search agencies. You will roll up your sleeves, drive the search strategy yourself, and personally manage the relationship with high-profile candidates.

What We Are Looking For

  • Extensive experience in Executive Search / Headhunting, specifically focusing on C-level, VP, or Founder-level placements within the tech, digital, or SaaS sectors.

  • Venture Capital / Private Equity Exposure: Experience working within or closely alongside VC funds, startup accelerators, or high-growth tech ecosystems is a major advantage.

  • Deep Business Acumen: You understand how startups operate, fundraise, and scale. Terms like ARR, runway, cap table, dilution, and Series A are second nature to you.

  • Masterful Negotiation & Discretion: Exceptional emotional intelligence, diplomacy, and negotiation skills, with a proven ability to close complex executive offers involving equity components.

  • Fluent English: Impeccable command of English and Polish, both spoken and written, suitable for communicating with international investors and high-profile executives.

What We Offer

  • High-Impact Position: You will have a seat at the table, directly influencing who leads our next big spin-off and shaping the future of Red Sky’s portfolio.

  • Elite Networking: Continuous engagement with top-tier business minds, tech innovators, and venture capitalists across Europe and beyond.

  • Premium Compensation: A competitive salary package mapped to your seniority, experience, and the strategic value you bring.

  • True Entrepreneurial Culture: An environment that champions bold ideas, swift decision-making, and complete professional freedom over corporate bureaucracy.

Important Note: This is an open-ended application for our Talent Pipeline. At Red Sky, we are constantly validating new business ideas and launching new ventures. We want to build relationships with exceptional talent ahead of time, so that when a new startup spins off or a new funding round closes, we can fast-track you into active roles. If your profile matches our vision, we will invite you for an introductory call to discuss your career aspirations and future synergy.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description: We are looking for a talented and ambitious Growth Marketing Manager to drive the growth of Freebird Club internationally and lead our marketing and branding efforts.

raw.title: Growth Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a talented and ambitious Growth Marketing Manager to drive the growth of Freebird Club internationally and lead our marketing and branding efforts.
raw.description:
We are looking for a talented and ambitious Growth Marketing Manager to drive the growth of Freebird Club internationally and lead our marketing and branding efforts. The ideal candidate will be motivated by the opportunity to create real value + impact in the world. You will join a small, growing team in a fast-paced, supportive, mission driven start-up, with lots of opportunities to partake in strategic and operational initiatives. This is a role for someone who wants to use their market oriented skills in an innovative and impactful context. If you’re motivated by shaping the future of ageing, and are not afraid to join us in the deep end for challenging but meaningful work, then this might be the role for you.

This Growth Marketing Manager position is a rare opportunity to join an exciting new impact venture in its nascent growth stage, and take a central role in achieving our scaling ambitions globally. As the Growth Marketing Manager, you will drive our digital and offline marketing, branding, positioning and community growth as we strive to bring Freebird club to the masses.

Responsibilities include:

  • Drive Freebird’s marketing (digital and offline), branding, positioning and community growth.
  • Develop and implement growth marketing campaigns, with a focus on content marketing, social media marketing, paid and organic advertising.
  • Mastering all things PPC (AdWords, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) as efficiently as possible.
  • Develop a unified approach to the company’s overall marketing efforts in collaboration with the community, product, and design teams.
  • Create brand marketing campaigns aimed at increasing brand awareness and engaging with existing and new audiences.
  • Actively investigate and identify high potential growth opportunities to test and incorporate into channel strategy.
  • Leverage community reporting and analytic tools (Google Analytics, Think with Google, Google Trends) during market research to find ways to enhance the company’s marketing efforts.
  • Define, measure and understand our growth metrics and KPIs.
  • Analyse, review and improve AdWords and Google Analytics performance.
  • Contribute to content creation (Mailshots, Ads, Website copy, newsletter etc)
  • Work closely with the CEO, CTO and development team on product improvements based on user feedback
  • Develop a robust understanding of both the silver economy and travel & tourism industry.
  • Make Freebird Club a thought-leader and go-to brand in the silver economy.
  • Stay on top of the latest trends and emergent issues in our sector (incl. business model changes, new products, features etc)
  • Work with the Community manager to ensure the company blog, social media accounts, website and content are all optimized for market positioning.
  • Compile performance reports to brief senior leadership on marketing initiatives and product performance and provide recommendations on improvement.
  • Minimum 5 years experience in a marketing or sales leadership role.
  • Extensive experience of digital marketing, including strategy development, managing and writing content, managing campaigns and website CMS.
  • Degree in Marketing or related field (e.g. psychology, hospitality).
  • Proven track record of successful growth campaigns, especially for early stage products or communities.
  • Startup experience is a plus.
  • Expertise with SEO and software and analytical tools for marketers, such as Google Analytics, Google Trends, Semrush, Hubspot or similar email tool, Salesforce, website CMS.
  • Superior organisational skills and ability to prioritise takss.
  • Strong analytical skills,with great attention to detail.
  • Ability to quickly gather data and present back findings/recommendations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to create quality content.
  • Self-directed; ability to get lots done with sometimes limited guidance. Takes ownership.
  • Demonstrate integrity, dependability, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, empathy.

What’s in it for you?

  • Coming in at exciting early stage in an award-winning social impact start-up.
  • Working directly with the Founders on all aspects of the business, gaining first-hand experience of bringing a high-growth startup to life and executing on our ambitions.
  • Remote-first & flexible culture: we believe in outcomes over time-keeping.
  • Use of Founders Factory office at fantastic location near Covent Garden, London.
  • Be part of the Founders Factory entrepreneurial ecosystem, with access to excellent free training, advice and contacts.
  • Your work will have real & meaningful impact in improving the lives of older people.
  • Personal development – you will have exposure to all aspects of the business with rare opportunities for learning and growth.
  • Work from home – with occasional team days in London.
  • Salary £40-46K with early employee equity options.
  • Generous pension scheme and annual holiday entitlement.

We are committed to building a diverse culture and are eager to receive applications from all backgrounds. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination.

Freebird Club is a social travel & homestay club for the over 50s. It offers an accessible new mode of travelling for older adults, a fun way to meet and enjoy social & cultural interaction, and a means to unlock value in their homes and earn income in later life. Positioned at the intersection of traveltech and agetech, where the silver economy meets the sharing economy, Freebird addresses social issues such as loneliness and lack of opportunities for older adults through a tech enabled community model. Our mission is to connect, empower and enrich the lives of older adults through meaningful travel & social experiences.

Our ambitions are big, bold and global. We are looking to build a highly talented, mission-driven team that is excited at the prospect of enriching the lives of older people globally, and creating a more age-friendly and accessible world that we can all look forward to growing old in.

Freebird Club is backed by Founders Factory and Nesta. Founders Factory builds and funds start-ups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. We have just completed their mission-focused accelerator program centred on healthy ageing. We have also secured a sizeable grant from Innovate UK to pursue our impact mission.

London UK base; remote first.

NOTE: Applicants must be UK work eligible - we are not in a position to provide visas at this time.

raw.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
raw.excerpt: Ideal start timeline: July 2026Role status: ExemptCompensation: Our target hiring range is $175,000-$215,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $12,000 bonus.
raw.description:
Ideal start timeline: July 2026

Role status: Exempt

Compensation: Our target hiring range is $175,000-$215,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $12,000 bonus. Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

Campminder’s Flexible Working Location: Our employees have the option to work 100% remotely within the United States in select states where Campminder has established entities or their choice of days at home and at our office in Boulder, Colorado. We host a variety of all-company hybrid meetings and social events. We require anybody working remotely to have a very reliable, high-speed internet connection.

We know the best people can choose to work anywhere.

Here’s a few reasons why 100+ of them choose Campminder:

  • With 20+ years experience of serving the industry through its digital transformation, we’re stable, profitable, and have developed a loyal customer base (that continues to grow).
  • We build software for summer camps, an industry that enables meaningful experiences for kids.
  • We work on interesting, ambitious projects that create real value for our clients.
  • We know our team members feel their work has an impact on the organization’s purpose.
  • At the same time, we are genuinely committed to work/life balance. Our team members feel they have the flexibility to take time off when needed and feel supported in making use of flexible working arrangements.
  • We invest in emerging technology and cutting-edge leadership and are proud to take an "AI-Enabled" approach in our solutions.
  • We’ve been listed on Outside Magazine’s 50 Best Places to Work for 8 consecutive years for our values-led culture and employee experience.

This role’s mission & overview: We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform team, which owns AI enablement internally across Campminder, and externally to our customers. As a senior engineer on the team, you will be partnering directly with our executive leadership team to identify the greatest needs for AI enablement and AI tooling across all of Campminder, and then working with teams across the company to co-build AI solutions that improve efficiency and empowerment for those teams. You will also be partnering with our product team to build AI solutions that will empower external customers and internal engineers to use agentic coding tools to customize Campminder products. This will be a highly visible role, focused on partnering with stakeholders across the business to bring Campminder at the leading edge of AI enablement and AI platforms.

Candidates should be solid in at least two of the following three areas: AI expertise, AI enablement of technical and non-technical teammates, and building scalable software — with a genuine eagerness to grow in the third.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives on solving hard technical problems that unlock a whole new way of working at Campminder, while being in close collaboration with people across the entire company.

As a Senior AI Engineer on our AI Platform team, you will:

  • Partner with executives to identify areas at Campminder that would benefit most from AI enablement
  • Partner with teams across Campminder to define clear business metrics that you can improve with the help of AI, and then enable teams to build and maintain AI-powered tools that achieve those goals
  • Partner with product to design and build AI platform and harness engineering tooling, that can be used by both internal engineers and external customers to expand on the Campminder platform
  • Design AI best practices across all of Campminder, and build platform functionality to make it easy and automated to follow those best practices
  • Partner with our DevOps team to roll out AI-first development and CI/CD flows, that scale to the needs of high-velocity agentic coding
  • Be a mentor and collaborator for people across all of Campminder, teaching people how to build AI-powered tools that make their lives better and help them be more effective

We think a successful candidate will bring:

  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered tools used by internal teams of varying skill levels and technical backgrounds
  • Experience with RAG, prompt engineering, context engineering, and LLM evals
  • Experience building production AI observability, including prompt/input/output logging, token spend tracking, and regression evaluations
  • Experience extending or building on agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCPs, custom agents, skills/plugins) for use in customer-facing development workflows
  • Excellent product judgment about where AI belongs in a product and where deterministic code is the better answer
  • Actively tracks the AI tooling landscape and actively experiments to form informed opinions on what works best for different use cases
  • Experience teaching non-engineers practical, targeted AI adoption
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with executive leadership and individual contributors at any skill level, translating AI concepts appropriately for each audience
  • Exceptional communication skills, with an ability to communicate effectively with executives on AI strategy tied to clear business outcomes
  • Growth mindset, with a desire to constantly learn and improve themselves

Our Interview Process:

  1. 45 min - interview with People & Culture
  2. 60 min - interview with Hiring Manager
  3. Phase 3
    1. 60 min - technical interview with engineering team members
    2. 30 min - cultural interview with engineering team peers
    3. 30 min - peer interview with product and business operations
    4. 30 min - interview with CTO

A few of the benefits we are proud to offer:

  • Robust medical, dental, and vision coverage options with generous employer contributions, plus a $500 employer HSA contribution for HSA-compatible plans
  • Ability to choose where you work - remotely, in the office, or a mix!
  • A variety of resources to support mental health and emotional well-being
  • 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for all new parents, including via adoption, surrogacy, and foster care
  • 401(k) with 4% company matching
  • Trust-Based (flexible) PTO (and yes, we use it!)
  • $900/year wellness allowance
  • Company-paid subscriptions, training, and support for using AI professionally and personally. We have a team dedicated to enabling our AI capabilities for our team members and our customers!

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply:

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you!

We encourage applications from parents, parents-to-be, and those responsible for the caretaking of others. We offer paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents (including for adoption, surrogacy, and foster care placement) and paid loss leave to recover from miscarriage or stillbirth. The company's HSA and wellness allowance contributions may be used toward childcare, eldercare, adoption fees, and fertility treatments like IVF, among other expenses.

raw.title: E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space?
raw.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

raw.description:
The Daily Wire is seeking a Marketing Manager, Entertainment to lead the execution of high-impact marketing campaigns across our growing entertainment portfolio, including film, television, streaming, and live events. This role is responsible for translating high-level strategy into actionable, full-funnel campaigns that drive audience growth, engagement, and conversion. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of creativity and performance—bringing strong executional discipline, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful launches and sustained momentum for our entertainment properties.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead development and execution of full-funnel marketing campaigns across film, television, streaming, and live events—from concept through launch and optimization
  • Translate high-level marketing strategies into actionable campaign plans that drive awareness, engagement, and conversion
  • Write clear, strategic creative briefs outlining objectives, audience, messaging, and success metrics
  • Partner with creative teams to develop compelling, breakthrough campaign assets
  • Drive audience growth and engagement across digital channels, including social, email, and distribution platforms
  • Manage campaign timelines, marketing calendars, and cross-functional workflows to ensure on-time execution
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and continuously optimize for improved results
  • Track and report on conversion metrics such as ticket sales, subscriptions, and customer acquisition
  • Apply expertise in direct-to-consumer and subscription-based models to drive growth, retention, and lifetime value
  • Stay current on entertainment trends, audience behaviors, and competitive campaigns to inform strategy
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with content, creative, production, and growth teams to ensure alignment across all initiatives

Experience & Requirements

  • 7-10+ years of experience
  • Background in Marketing, Communications, Media, or a related field preferred
  • Experience marketing entertainment content (film, television, streaming, or live events)
  • Proven success executing full-funnel campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes (e.g., ticket sales, subscriptions)
  • Strong understanding of direct-to-consumer and subscription-based business models
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams from strategy through execution
  • Experience writing creative briefs and leading cross-functional campaign development
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and optimize campaigns
  • Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills
  • Preferred: Experience in a studio, streaming platform, or similar media environment

raw.description:
Job Description – Customer Success Manager

Cartful is changing the way that brands engage with their shoppers online. Using interactive shopping experiences, we build shopper confidence while delivering valuable “zero-party” data back to our clients. Each experience is configured to our client’s unique industry use case using our proprietary software platform and tried and tested implementation process. We’re working with fantastic brands like Peet's Coffee, Arc'teryx, Otterbox, bareMinerals, Skechers, Lumber Liquidators, HOKA One One, and Bombas and are growing quickly.

We are seeking an experienced account manager to join our Customer Success organization. Here at Cartful, we call this role the Optimization Manager because their primary responsibility is to use the analytics at their disposal to make data-driven improvements, or optimizations, to each client’s personalized on-site product recommender. These improvements help us build strong client relationships that allow us to maintain our industry-leading customer retention.

New York City or San Diego metropolitan areas preferred, but open to remote locations for the ideal candidate.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with core and secondary stakeholders, exploring additional areas of account growth
  • Engage in proactive account management to help secure the annual contract renewal
  • Become a SME (Subject Matter Expert) in Google Data Studio, modifying each client’s performance dashboard to their specific needs
  • Monitor client data to identify areas for account optimization
  • Make sure that each client account is always working and making strong product recommendations
  • Transcribe client requests into clear, descriptive and actionable development tickets
  • Keep clients updated with progress on all outstanding development tickets & service requests
  • Request and deliver case studies, client quotes and referrals

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, ecommerce or related field
  • 3+ years of professional client management experience in a fast growing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn technical concepts quickly and communicate to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a startup environment
  • Previous experience working with ecommerce brands
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Data Studio
  • Experience collaborating with developers

Chances are you’ll love this job if:

  • The idea of working as part of a fast-paced, quickly growing startup is thrilling to you. You’re resilient. You’re able to handle the ups and downs of working in this environment.
  • You’re a systems thinker. You want to find the most efficient way to get things done. You’ll only do manual tasks if you can’t figure out a way to automate it.
  • You’re a team player. You’re at your best when your work contributes to a larger goal. You like putting other people into a position where they can be successful.

raw.description:
TurFresh is a leading provider of artificial turf maintenance products and services. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional quality and service to our clients. Our innovative solutions have positioned us as industry leaders, and we're now seeking a skilled SEO Strategist to join our dynamic team.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Remote SEO Strategist who has a comprehensive understanding of full-stack SEO, with a strong focus on content, keywords, and SEO strategy. This role is perfect for a motivated individual who is both a leader and a team player, capable of building our SEO department in the long term. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in performing SEO audits, automatic analysis and driving lead generation, and ranking improvements.

Key Responsibilities

    • SEO Strategy Development: Design and implement comprehensive SEO strategies, including on-page, off-page, and technical SEO to boost website visibility, traffic, and conversions.

    • Content Strategy: Collaborate with the content team to create and optimize content that aligns with SEO best practices, targeting relevant keywords and improving user engagement.

    • Keyword Research & Analysis: Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify opportunities and ensure our content is optimized for high-traffic, high-conversion terms.

    • SEO Audits & Analysis: Perform regular SEO audits and automatic analysis of the website to identify areas for improvement and ensure adherence to best practices.

    • Lead Generation & Ranking Improvement: Develop and execute strategies to increase lead generation and improve search engine rankings.

    • Team Leadership: Play a pivotal role in building and scaling the SEO department, providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members while also being willing to follow established processes and guidelines.

    • Performance Monitoring: Use various analytics tools to monitor and report on the performance of SEO efforts, making data-driven decisions to continually improve outcomes.

    • Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to ensure SEO objectives are met at a timely manner.

    • Project management: Conceptualize and effectively coordinate SEO projects with partner agencies and leadership teams.

Qualifications

    • Proven experience as an SEO Strategist or similar role, with a deep understanding of full stack SEO.

    • Strong knowledge of SEO tools and software for auditing, keyword research, and analytics.

    • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and teams, with a long-term vision to scale an SEO department.

    • Experience with lead generation and improving search engine rankings.

    • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

    • Familiarity with the latest SEO trends and best practices.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

raw.description:
Foodiary, ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich gesunder Ernährungsumstellung. Aktuell arbeiten wir deutschlandweit mit über 100 Online Ernährungsberatern und Coaches, sowie über 300 Kooperationspartnern zusammen.

Foodiary bietet dir zahlreiche Vorteile:

  1. 🍎 Gesunde Ernährung leicht gemacht: Foodiary hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, gesunde Ernährung für jeden einfach und zugänglich zu gestalten. Als Online Coach profitierst du von unserem bewährten Ansatz, der auf modernster Technologie und persönlicher Beratung beruht. Unsere Klienten erhalten eine smarte Ernährungsplaner App und zusätzlich eine große Lernacademy.
  2. ✅ Zertifizierung der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen: Wir sind stolz darauf, von allen deutschen Krankenkassen anerkannt zu sein, was bedeutet, dass wir noch mehr Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einer gesünderen Lebensweise unterstützen können und teilweise bis zu 100% der Kosten für unsere Klienten zurückerstattet werden.
  3. 🤝 Bewährtes Geschäftsmodell: Foodiary bietet ein erprobtes Geschäftsmodell, das auf nachhaltigem Erfolg und Wachstum ausgerichtet ist.
  4. 📚 Umfassende Schulung und Unterstützung: Als Foodiary Coach erhältst du umfassende Schulungen und laufende Unterstützung, um deine Online Ernährungsberatung erfolgreich auf- und auszubauen.

Wenn du also Leidenschaft für gesunde Ernährung und unternehmerische Motivation mitbringst, laden wir dich herzlich ein, uns im ersten Schritt dein Motivationsschreiben zuzusenden.

Nutze diese einzigartige Gelegenheit, Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem gesünderen Lebensstil zu begleiten und dir gleichzeitig dein eigenes Online Unternehmen aufzubauen.

Aufgaben

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstberatung und Betreuung neuer Klienten.
  • Du präsentierst die Dienstleistung von Foodiary, erstellst mit unserer Software Ernährungspläne und unterstützt mit wertvollen Tipps und Tricks bei der Ernährungsumstellung.
  • Als Ansprechpartner stehst du Deinen Klienten dauerhaft zur Verfügung.
  • Du leitest eigenständig Workshops bei Kooperationspartnern sowohl, als auch Online Webinare.
  • Du bist maßgeblich an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Software beteiligt.
  • Als selbstständiger Foodiary Coach baust du mit unserer Hilfe deine eigenes Online Coaching für eine gesunde Ernährung auf.

Qualifikation

  • Wenn du bereits erste Erfahrung im Bereich der Ernährungsberatung hast, schätzen wir dies natürlich sehr. Jedoch freuen wir uns auch, wenn du Dich als Quereinsteiger mit einem fundierten Grundwissen bei uns bewirbst.
  • Du kennst die Grundlagen einer gesunden und abwechslungsreichen Ernährung, kennst dich mit Kalorien, Lebensmitteln und verschiedenen Ernährungsformen aus.
  • Große Begeisterung für eine gesunde Ernährung
  • Du kannst dich mit unserer Mission indizieren.
  • Hohes Maß an Engagement.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote Arbeit möglich 🌎
  • Zeitunabhänig und flexibel möglich 🕖
  • Ideal zum Einstieg in die Selbstständigkeit im Nebenerwerb 🏃‍♂️
  • Attraktive und Leistungsbezogene Vergütung 🙌
  • Gemeinsame Urlaube und Events 🕺

Wenn du dir die Tätigkeit als Foodiary Coach vorstellen kannst, du Menschen auf dem Weg zu einer gesunden Ernährung unterstützen möchtest und dabei die Leidenschaft für eine erfolgreiche und ortsunabhänige Selbstständigkeit mitbringst, dann sende uns dein Motivationsschreiben. 🤝

Wir bitten um die Kenntnisnahme, dass es sich hierbei um eine selbsttändige Tätigkeit handelt. ☺️
